seed_semantics: Proposed future replay seed, not executed. A seed is not evidence that the required canonical reset conditions hold.
precondition_policy: The future executor must inspect the actual reset under its separately authorized replay. If these conditions do not match, report SCRIPT_PRECONDITION_UNSATISFIED; do not overwrite the reset, silently relabel agents, change recipes, or claim this conditional script proves a failure/success. Any seed search needs its own declared procedure.
action_semantics: Rows are simultaneous integer actions in agent-ID order, applied one row per raw_step. Legalness is a manually reasoned conditional hypothesis, not an observed legal-mask receipt.
intended_objectives: Steps 1..2: agent 2 walks to the west plate of gate 0.
Steps 3..7: agents 0 and 1 jointly haul east five cells.
Steps 8..9: agent 0 takes gate 0's east plate.
Steps 10..20: agent 2 crosses gate 0 and reaches gate 1's west plate.
Steps 21..22: agent 0 returns to the pallet flank.
Steps 23..27: the pair hauls east five cells through gate 1.
Steps 28..29: agent 1 takes gate 1's east plate.
Steps 30..34: agent 2 crosses into the east chamber.
Steps 35..36: agent 1 returns to the pallet flank.
Step 37: one more east haul is intended to put the pallet at [14,5] with all workers east.
terminal_hypothesis: Natural success on the final row is an unexecuted conditional hypothesis, not observed.
caveats: No candidate import, JAX execution, rollout or frame rendering occurred while authoring. Intended timing follows the proposed source rules by inspection only. Actual reset permutations and recipes remain randomized.
